summary: Your doctor-led clinic offers a wide menu, but the site shows no proof and sends bookings down three different paths.

findings.problem: No patient reviews, testimonials or before and after images appear on the page.
findings.cost: Injectable and laser patients choose on proof, so they go to the clinic that shows results.
findings.fix: Review wall and consented, captioned results.

findings.problem: Book Now goes to Timely, the footer Bookings link goes to /book-appointment, and Book an appointment today goes to /contact-us.
findings.cost: Three booking paths confuse patients and lose bookings.
findings.fix: One booking path, shown the same way on every page.

findings.problem: Footer headings link to #, the Threadlift menu and footer go to different URLs, and stray text like Folder: About appears.
findings.cost: Dead links and leftover template text look unfinished on a medical site.

findings.problem: No WhatsApp, phone only (0413 000 228), the footer says 2024, and treatments are repeated under different names.
findings.cost: Younger patients expect to message, and repeated menus make treatments hard to find.
findings.fix: WhatsApp button, current copy and one menu entry per treatment.

redesign: One booking button and WhatsApp on every page.
Reviews, results and named doctors shown beside each treatment.
